Building and bases

How can I reduce gaps between fences?

When placing fences, adjacent sections now snap together and align automatically. This makes a continuous perimeter easier to build and reduces gaps enemies can peek or shoot through. The source describes alignment during placement; it does not say that existing gaps repair themselves.
